Healthcare and other fields must remain available to the company. I found this restriction in the executed amendment but have not yet circulated it in the current license-markup thread, so I want to flag it now before we proceed.

transcript.text: During a client-priority call this week, Meridian's general counsel stated that Meridian will proceed only if it may sublicense the licensed analytics to its named distributor, Orion Industrial, while the company retains ownership and use of all background technology and newly developed improvements. I recorded this instruction in my relationship notes, but it has not yet been incorporated into the draft term sheet. Given that our current draft grants Meridian broad sublicensing rights and rights in improvements, we need to make sure the final terms reflect these conditions precisely — sublicensing limited to Orion Industrial, and clear reservation of our ownership and use of background technology and improvements.
